messages:
Ava: Proposal: run an "Observability-first" design partner cohort (n=12). Goal: validate our DP console flows, alerting, and the token/latency attribution pipeline before we GA the monitoring surface.
Jordan: +1. We should scope the cohort to teams that already have internal tracing or strong infra teams so we can compare signals.
Ken: For analytics we need a minimal schema and unique request ids. Fields: request_id, model, route, tenant_id (hashed), tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, cache_hit. Keep it small.
Sam: Ops note: we'll need to enable debug telemetry for each DP env and a temporary elevated retention. That adds storage costs; recommend 6-week retention window for cohort.
Diego: Measurement plan: dashboard created, three signal checks (p50 latency, cost per 1K tokens, tail error rate), and at least one actionable alert per DP. Also capture qualitative "observability friction" notes.
Maya: Recruitment: look for customers who asked for deeper cost/latency breakdowns in the past quarter. Incentive: one free audit + $250 credit. A/B test subject lines focused on "visibility" vs "reliability".
Priya: Legal: must add an explicit telemetry consent checkbox in the invite and a line about anonymization + limited retention. I'll draft the snippet; also flag any PHI concerns if healthcare teams apply.
Renee: From CS: require a kickoff call and a runbook template we share. We'll need to capture one integration case study per DP to surface wins for sales.
Jordan: Onboarding checklist (short):
1) enable DP telemetry flag
2) run 20 sample requests with tracing header
3) verify dashboard ingest (ken will provide sample CSV)
4) schedule feedback + demo
Can we add an automated smoke test to validate step 2?
Sam: Yes, I can provide a script. It will run locally via curl and upload a small CSV to the analytics bucket. Need to lock access controls first.
Ken: I'll publish a tiny CSV/JSON example and a mapping doc. Also will add a filter tag `observability_dp` so PMs can slice.
Diego: Success gating for GA: show that cohort produced >=8 dashboards with live ingest, <2 false positives from alerts per DP, and at least 6 product suggestions prioritized for queuing.
Ava: Rollout plan: 12 DP seats, 3-week onboarding waves (4 each), 6-week total pilot, weekly syncs. If gating met, include observability as an official feature flag in next minor release.
Maya: Ops question: can we promise timeboxed dedicated support during onboarding? that affects conversion.
Sam: We can offer 6 dedicated support hours per DP during onboarding (staggered). Must limit to the pilot window.
Priya: Draft pilot terms: consent checkbox, retention window, limited liability, and data handling. I'll post copy by EOD.
dp-bot: Reminder: create entry in `dp-beta-queue` with tag `observability-first` and attach consent link when ready. :robot_face:
Ava: Next steps: Ken publishes schema & example; Sam posts smoke test script; Priya posts consent blurb; Maya drafts invite copy; Renee prepares runbook template; Diego finalizes gating metrics. I'll assemble the pilot spec and timeline and share for final sign-off tomorrow.
